name: team_pass_yards_from_plays on player view with week split and no year split (wrap MUST NOT fire)
description: Regression: a week split with no year split spanning 2+ years must not trigger the team-stats-from-plays wrap. The wrap CTE groups to (pid)-grain (no week); if it fired, the single aggregated value would fan out across every per-week outer row and inflate stats by the number of selected weeks. The standard year-aware row grain is required for week-split views, so this fixture pins that the `_team_stats` CTE remains (nfl_team, year, week)-keyed and the outer join uses team + year + week predicates.
expected_query:
with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2023,2024]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years WHERE player.primary_position IN ('WR')), "player_years_weeks" as (SELECT player_years.pid, nfl_year_week_timestamp.year, nfl_year_week_timestamp.week FROM player_years INNER JOIN nfl_year_week_timestamp ON player_years.year = nfl_year_week_timestamp.year), "tf8113f1ffa6e367142c0be84075b9b52" as materialized (select "nfl_plays"."offense_nfl_team" as "nfl_team", SUM(pass_yards) AS team_pass_yds_from_plays, "nfl_plays"."week" from "nfl_plays" where "play_type" in ('PASS', 'RUSH', 'KOFF', 'PUNT', 'FGXP', 'FREE') and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2023, 2024) group by "nfl_plays"."offense_nfl_team", "nfl_plays"."week"), "tf8113f1ffa6e367142c0be84075b9b52_team_stats" as materialized (select "tf8113f1ffa6e367142c0be84075b9b52"."nfl_team", sum(tf8113f1ffa6e367142c0be84075b9b52.team_pass_yds_from_plays) as team_pass_yds_from_plays, "tf8113f1ffa6e367142c0be84075b9b52"."week" from "tf8113f1ffa6e367142c0be84075b9b52" group by "tf8113f1ffa6e367142c0be84075b9b52"."nfl_team", "tf8113f1ffa6e367142c0be84075b9b52"."week"), "player_year_teams" as materialized (select "pid", "year", (array_agg(nfl_team ORDER BY game_count DESC, nfl_team ASC))[1] as team from (select "player_gamelogs"."pid", "nfl_games"."season_year" as "year", "player_gamelogs"."nfl_team", count(*) as "game_count" from "player_gamelogs" inner join "nfl_games" on "nfl_games"."esbid" = "player_gamelogs"."esbid" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023, 2024) and "player_gamelogs"."season_year" in (2023, 2024) group by "player_gamelogs"."pid", "nfl_games"."season_year", "player_gamelogs"."nfl_team") as "player_year_team_counts" group by "pid", "year"), "player_participation_weeks" as (SELECT pid, year, week, bool_or(is_active) AS is_active
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, g.week, pgl.is_active
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023 UNION ALL SELECT pgl.pid, 2024::int AS year, g.week, pgl.is_active
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2024 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2024) src
          GROUP BY pid, year, week), "player_years_teams" as (SELECT pid, year, array_agg(DISTINCT team_code) AS teams
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE pgl.is_active = TRUE AND g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023 UNION ALL SELECT pgl.pid, 2024::int AS year, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2024 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE pgl.is_active = TRUE AND g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2024) src
          GROUP BY pid, year), "team_weeks_played" as (select distinct "team", "year", "week" from ((select "home_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023, 2024)) union all (select "away_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023, 2024))) as "g") select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "tf8113f1ffa6e367142c0be84075b9b52_team_stats"."team_pass_yds_from_plays" AS "team_pass_yds_from_plays_0", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END AS participation_status, "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years_weeks" on "player_years_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "player_year_teams" on "player_year_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_year_teams"."year" = 2024 left join "tf8113f1ffa6e367142c0be84075b9b52_team_stats" on "tf8113f1ffa6e367142c0be84075b9b52_team_stats"."nfl_team" = "player_year_teams"."team" and tf8113f1ffa6e367142c0be84075b9b52_team_stats.week = player_years_weeks.week left join "player_participation_weeks" on "player_participation_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_participation_weeks"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "player_participation_weeks"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" left join "player_years_teams" on "player_years_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_teams"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" where player.primary_position IN ('WR') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "tf8113f1ffa6e367142c0be84075b9b52_team_stats"."team_pass_yds_from_plays", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by 4 DESC NULLS LAST, "player"."pid" asc limit 500
